steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on the buyer's Master QCS screen.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Verify both bidding vendors appear as real vendor columns.
Check Vendor A's unit bid rate.
Check Vendor B's unit bid rate.
Verify Vendor A's offered quantity matches the prepared API quantity.
Verify Vendor A's line amount and total are calculated from rate multiplied by quantity.
Verify Vendor B's line amount and total are calculated from rate multiplied by quantity.
Verify the lower bid ranks first in the closed comparison.
Confirm the Master QCS renders without invalid numeric values or application errors.
